name: Duplicity
source:
You play as a struggling writer living in a one bedroom apartment. You work at a secondhand bookstore run by Magdalene Smith, a woman who is more of a mother to you than your actual mother ever was. For three years, she and you ran the bookstore by yourselves until she hired Dell Franklin, a grumpy 20-something that only seems to get along with Mags, and possibly you.

It is here at your work that you meet 25 year old Griffin Wells. He's everything you've been looking for; tall, cute, and into the same things you're into!

However, strange things start happening to you, things that suddenly involve your young upstairs neighbor Sophie Graves, your best friend Tris Solis, and even your co-worker Dell. Things that start to make you question if there may be more to Griffin than he's letting on...

Will you be able to figure it out and keep your friends safe?

[Edited from Itch.io]
translation:
你扮演一名住在一间卧室公寓里苦苦挣扎的作家。你在一家由玛格达琳·史密斯（Magdalene Smith）经营的二手书店工作，她对你来说比你真正的母亲更像是母亲。三年来，她和你独自经营这家书店，直到她雇佣了戴尔·富兰克林（Dell Franklin），一个脾气暴躁的20多岁的人，似乎只与玛格斯相处融洽，也可能与你相处融洽。

正是在你的工作场所，你认识了25岁的格里芬·威尔斯 (Griffin Wells)。他就是你一直在寻找的一切；高大、可爱，而且和你喜欢的东西一样！

然而，奇怪的事情开始发生在你身上，这些事情突然涉及到你年轻的楼上邻居索菲·格雷夫斯、你最好的朋友特里斯·索利斯，甚至你的同事戴尔。这些事情开始让你怀疑格里芬是否有比他所透露的更多的东西……

你能解决这个问题并保证你朋友的安全吗？

[编辑自Itch.io]
